Bucket Shop: hold it, own it, get paid your way.
A 3% fee on every BUCKET trade buys real tokenized stocks and crypto and delivers them straight to holder wallets, automatically. No staking, no claiming, no wrapper. Pick a preset Bucket (Core, Tech, Chips, Markets, Crypto, Degen) or name any 1 to 20 assets yourself. Payouts clear at a $2 floor, so small holders get paid too.
